cohort: The cohort consisted of 200 low-risk pregnant women between 37 and 41 weeks gestation, attending the labor room in early labor or prelabor phase.
finding: The Non Stress Test (NST) was a good predictor of healthy fetuses in low-risk pregnancies, with abnormal NST categories (2 and 3) increasing the probability of adverse outcomes such as meconium stained liquor, low APGAR score, and NICU admission.
mod_finding: Caesarean section rates were higher in pregnancies with abnormal (category 2 and 3) Non Stress Tests.
